subject: Aboard the colony ship ariadne, in the bay where the work is being done. Andrea wants to teach Toby's watch to pack a wound and tie off a bleed: two shifts a month, off their posts. "Somebody's going to bleed in the spine one day, Toby, and it'll be one of yours on the end of the stretcher, so I'd like them to know what to do with their hands before it happens." Only these two officers are seen clearly; the other four at the table or on the ship are faceless: backs turned, in shadow or cut off by the frame.
